title: Purpose
author: 64cf7168c6edd65797781320
chapter_outcomes: Students will be able to write a 120-160 word review to inform readers about a specific place, thing, incident, or service.
Students will be able to construct an introduction that opens with a hook and explicitly names the subject of the review.
Students will be able to describe the special features that make a subject stand out from its competitors.
Students will be able to formulate a balanced review by strategically combining positive and negative opinions.
Students will be able to arrange 3-4 distinct opinions effectively within a dedicated body paragraph.
Students will be able to conclude a review by specifying the target audience they would or would not recommend the subject to.
Students will be able to assign an appropriate numerical rating at the end of their review.
Students will be able to maintain a consistent formal or semi-formal tone while appropriately utilizing personal pronouns.
